key_features: Dual-Generation CPU Support: Compatible with 13th and 14th Gen Intel processors for versatile performance options.
DDR4 Memory Support: Two DDR4 memory sockets supporting up to 64GB for enhanced multitasking capabilities.
PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot: High-speed data transfer rates for seamless gaming and demanding applications.
M-ATX Form Factor: Compact size with powerful capabilities for diverse system builds.
Optimized Power Delivery: Ensures stable and efficient power distribution for enhanced performance.
Comprehensive I/O Ports: External interfaces for diverse peripheral connectivity needs.
SATA 6Gb/s Interfaces: Support for high-speed data storage devices for faster access to data.
M.2 Slots: Two M.2 slots accommodating PCIe 4.0 x4 SSDs for rapid data transfer.
RAID Support: Capability to create RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 disk arrays using SATA HDDs.
Integrated Cooling Support: Headers for CPU fan, system fans, and water cooling pumps for temperature control.
BIOS Features: 128M UEFI BIOS supporting multiple languages for easy setup and customization.
Hardware Monitoring: Comprehensive monitoring of CPU temperature, system temperature, and voltage levels.
